move: bar fills in three pushes with a sheen, counter ticks, completes green
how: A dark panel with a title, a track, a giant percentage and a four-step row rises in. The bar fills by scaleX in three pushes: 0 to .42 (expo.out, 10-30%), .42 to .68 (36-54%) and .68 to 1 (expo.inOut, 59-81%), the big number counting in sync via an onUpdate tween. A white sheen strip sweeps x -140 to 800 three times (power1.inOut). Step dots switch on by className at fixed beats; label and ETA strings swap. At 79% the gradient turns green, a Complete pill pops with back.out(2.5), the number scales 1.06 and settles elastic; the panel lifts out at 92%.
adapt: Change the title, step names, status strings and the two gradients; keep the three-push fill rhythm (fast, pause, fast) and the sheen sweep so it reads as real progress.
port: mount(el, shot) builds the panel from shot.title/shot.steps; animate returns the timeline with pushes at 0.1D, 0.36D, 0.59D and completion at 0.8D. The text swaps use TextPlugin with duration 0 and className tweens; both work in the engine but scope querySelector for .pct/.lbl/.eta to el.
caveats: className tweens replace the whole class list, so keep the .st on markup exact
